title: B.C. funeral homes complain of lack of funding in provincial burial program
summary: British Columbia’s government helps to pay families who can’t afford funeral costs, but those who offer the services say the funding isn’t enough and could mean the demise of rural operators. title: US to Avoid Coastal Strike as Two Atlantic Storms Battle
summary: Tropical Storm Imelda has formed in the Bahamas and will likely miss striking the US East Coast from Florida to North Carolina thanks to more powerful Hurricane Humberto hundreds of miles to its east.

title: Moldova awaits election results in vote plagued by Russian interference claims
